title: fix(dogfood): the audit-capability fixture's grant writes carry their holder's organization
body:
Refs #24780
Clause-②: no

**This PR repairs row 1 of the card (`Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)`). Row 2 (`Console Pin Gate`) belongs to #24749 and is not touched.** The card stays open for the PM to settle after this lands.

## What changed

One file: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/audit-log-audit-capability.dogfood.test.ts`. Its two `sys_user_permission_set` grant inserts ran in system context with no organization. Each now carries its holder's organization on the execution context (`{ isSystem: true, tenantId: ORG }`):

- **The walled case** (`[#21260] the ledger audit capability is bounded by its holder's organization (scope: org)`, `multiTenant: 'posture-only'`, so the `isolated` posture): the grant to the first owner carries `org.a`, the organization that owner created earlier in the same `beforeAll`.
- **The first describe** (a `single` boot): the `grant` helper reads the holder's one membership in `sys_member` and carries that organization (the Default Organization on that boot). The helper asserts exactly one non-empty membership. Without that check, an empty id would fall back to derivation and pass without testing anything.

No assertion of any case changed. `resolveSystemInsertOrganization` and the walled lift stay as they are.

**Why `tenantId` on the context rather than `organization_id` on the row:** the refusal names the context form first ("pass it on the execution context (`{ context: { isSystem: true, tenantId: ORGANIZATION_ID } }`), or set organization_id on the record itself"). It is also the form #24667 used for its own two walled fixtures (`builtin-positions.boot.test.ts`, `grant-holder-membership-refusal.test.ts`).

**The file's other system write**, the bulk `sys_audit_log` insert in the first describe, is not this shape and is unchanged. The ledger declares `systemFields: { tenant: false }` (ADR-0131 D7: no organization column), so `resolveTenantFieldName` answers null and the rule does not apply to that object. Its `single` boot would derive an organization anyway. The file makes no other `ql.insert` / update / delete calls.

## Evidence

All runs used `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/audit-log-audit-capability.dogfood.test.ts`, after building the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure at the same commit.

| tree | result |
|---|---|
| `f7005cbd8` (the parent of #24667's `fc34d000fc`) | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 13 passed (13)` |
| `fc34d000fc` (#24667, the walled lift) | `Test Files 1 failed (1)` · `Tests 10 passed \| 3 skipped (13)`, `SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError: Insert on 'sys_user_permission_set' was REFUSED … this install runs the 'isolated' tenancy posture` |
| `74f78159a` (this branch's base, `main` before the fix) | the same red: `1 failed`, `10 passed \| 3 skipped`, the same refusal, at `_ObjectQL.resolveSystemInsertOrganization` via `plugin-sharing` / `plugin-security` middleware |
| `187a247d0` (this head: the fix plus `main` at `46bb5e3e5`) | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 13 passed (13)` |

The bisect pair confirms #24667 as the cause. The case's own subject is unchanged: the holder case still reads `2` rows about its own organization's deleted record and `0` about the other's. That reading needs the grant (now stamped `org.a`) to be honoured for the holder.

The file runs in exactly one vitest project, `isolated` (it is not in `SHARED_SHOWCASE`). The gate runs `pnpm turbo run test --filter=@objectstack/dogfood` with `OS_TEST_SHARD=k/3`. The boot log shows the file's two boots at posture `single` and posture `isolated`. No boot in this file uses `group`.

## Gates

- Local, on `187a247d0`: the 55 commands of `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (narrowed to this diff) all exit 0. `--ran` reconciles them as `55 derived, 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0, no findings.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood run typecheck`: exit 0. The tsc program lists this file (`--listFilesOnly`, 1 hit).
- `Dogfood Regression Gate` does not run on `pull_request` or `merge_group`, so its first CI reading of this change is `main`'s push battery after the merge. The local red-then-green above is the pre-merge reading.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`: the diff is one test file in `@objectstack/dogfood`, a `private: true` package that publishes nothing. No published package's `files[]` changes.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch expected `group` and `single` runs of the same lines. Measured: the vitest projects are `shared-showcase` and `isolated`, and the file's boots are `single` (first describe) and `isolated` (second). There is no `group` boot here. Both grant lines answer under the boot they run in: `10 passed` before the lift and `13 passed` after this fix.
